newsitem.title: UK: Butte Mining told to amend full-year results.
newsitem.headline: Butte Mining told to amend full-year results.

text.p: Butte Mining Plc has been instructed to amend its results for the year ended June 30 1995, taking the group from a narrow pre-tax profit to a loss, the Financial Reporting Review Panel said on Wednesday.

In a statement, the official watchdog said Butte Mining should not have included profits on shares in a Canadian company, Gem River Corp, in its accounts as their value "could not be assessed with reasonable certainty" at the time.
Consequently it said Butte Mining results for the year should be stated as a pretax and net loss of 628,000 pounds compared with a previously-announced profit of 339,000 pounds.
The panel said Butte had agreed to change its acounts, and as a result no legal action would be taken against the company.
The statement said Butte had received shares in Gem River Corp during the year ended June 30, 1995 in return for services provided to the Canadian company.

However, trading in the Gem River shares on the Alberta Stock Exchange was still prohibited, under an escrow agreement, by the end of the reporting year pending the fulfilment of a number of conditions.
